prompt:
Match the attached APPROVED website concept's artwork exactly: sculpted hand-cut matte cardstock, clean cut edges, many visible layered paper planes with soft directional cast shadows, ivory and kraft borders, forest green #1e4b34, cream #f6f0df, olive/sage #859b61, golden yellow #efb34f and natural tan. No pink, blush, turquoise, watercolor, painted fur, plush texture or glossy plastic. This is actual artwork for integration, not another screenshot of the website. No UI labels, text, buttons, baby photos or watermark.
ONE square asset atlas, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, each cell isolated with generous transparent margins and no neighbors touching, no labels. Preserve real transparent background alpha0 between objects and all4corners. Row1: (1) EMPTY circular photo frame made of stacked scalloped ivory and gold cardstock, large transparent central opening, no photograph; (2) EMPTY upright rectangular portrait photo frame with softly scalloped ivory/gold edges, large transparent center, no photograph; (3) curved branch of six pairs of olive and sage paper leaves with dimensional folded midribs; (4) a wide blank golden paper ribbon with folded ends, no lettering. Row2: (1) full acacia tree sculpted from stacked sage leaves and kraft branches; (2) low wide strip of layered sage paper grass for the walking parade, delicate sparse blades, transparent edges; (3) small gold paper sun disk with no numeral; (4) small paper butterfly with ochre wings and tiny brown body. Row3: (1) small paper bird flying right, olive wings cream body; (2) a brass-and-sage paper-cut compass with no lettering; (3) olive-and-gold paper-cut binoculars; (4) a wide low organic layered cream-and-sage paper hillside strip for section dividers. No shadows that fill whole cell, no beige glow or background haze. This is a clean transparent cutout library matching the paper diorama.
